note: Character register modes (Alexander, 2026-08-31): what the character IS in the frame. Subsumes the retired authenticity dial (documentary->authentic, stylized->costume, cinematic->none). Per mode: sentence_pool = direct identification sentences (Alexander's design), wear = multipliers on the wear-state leans, marks = scar/marks probability multiplier, uniform_p + uniform_label = the role full-rig coin, family_wear = per-wardrobe-family wear overrides keyed to character_wardrobe.json families (the prestige fix: fine families keep their clothes even at authentic), exaggeration_pool = cartoon-only second sentence. Sentences draw LAST: register=none consumes no draws and reproduces the plain sheet byte-for-byte. Sentence language principle (Alexander, 2026-08-31, refined): the sentence speaks the class-agnostic realness axis only (real/well-made/well-fitted/clean; caption-frequent tokens, no negation, no metaphor, no aesthetic labels); the wear axis belongs to the wear tilts, which adapt per wardrobe family via family_wear. Authenticity is not grittiness - worn/faded is one class's signature, not the invariant.
